checkedSemantics: Original and copied real72x3 run must pass before any mutation. Each mutation restores exact baseline bytes; the copied positive must pass again after all33 controls. Mutators run outside the exporter-error catch, so fixture-construction failures cannot be counted as rejected bad receipts.

Raw comparison is recomputed from both capture indices/observations. Empty geometry/input/determinism arrays and wrong profile/passed flags are rejected; command role edits update report and command receipts together, raw observation edits rebind index SHA.

Actual command logs, source approval interpreter/script, same input/repeat/adapter policy, -I/empty PATH, metadata raw digest/path/current README and complete current package/license identities each have explicit controls.
Temporary output must be new/inside checkout/outside original run; resolved cleanup target stays below explicit output. Original full capture inventory and source files are rehashed after controls.

subprocess.Popen is blocked during the actual control run; no engine/installation/phase protocol is claimed. phaseProtocolAssessed/runtimeReexecuted/engineLaunched remain false; all33 rejection reasons are present and relevant to the targeted category.
limitations: Read-only independent tool/report review and actual original inventory/hash recomputation; the33 controls were genuinely executed by V, not rerun or attributed to B.
Receipt consistency cannot authenticate a fully forged execution chain or prove layout/API/lifecycle/release equivalence. Real current installed72 verification and source mathematics stay separate.
